name: Haus Tonin
beschreibung: The **Gasthof Haus Tonin** is located in the village centre of **Fulpmes** in the Stubaital. The accommodation offers a traditional **guest parlour** and several guest rooms. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom and satellite TV. The restaurant serves dishes of **Tiroler Küche**. The central location allows a short walk to shops and to the valley station **Schlick 2000**. Parking is available at the house. The **Stubaier Gletscher** can be reached by ski bus. In the surroundings of Fulpmes there is a network of hiking and cycling trails.
